entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane whose night aspect is Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: Lorwyn after the Great Aurora, with almost all its memories wiped clean.

entities.name: the Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that changed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, affecting only creatures present on the plane.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A Lorwyn figure who became a cruel pirate in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A faerie ruler with minions who steal dreams.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: A Lorwyn place that became Kinscaer in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The shattered plane of the Shards of Alara.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: One of the Shards of Alara, a land of undead savagery.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who features in the first planeswalker novel.

events.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor; features correspond but are changed, such as Kinsbaile becoming Kinscaer.
Sygg turns to cruel piracy in Shadowmoor.
events.quote: could recognize Sygg despite his new penchant for cruel piracy

events.summary: The events of the Time Spiral block change the planeswalker spark, making planeswalkers mortal.
events.quote: The events of the Time Spiral block changed the nature of the planeswalker spark

relations.note: Two aspects of the same plane.
relations.quote: Lorwyn and Shadowmoor are two aspects of the same plane
